newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer, bar steady fuel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer, bar steady fuel.

text.p: NWE oil markets were led higher by gasoline bar steady fuel.
Gasoline was $3-4 a tonne as NYMEX stormed higher and very tight supplies in NWE and the Mediterranean kicked in.

Euro high sulphur fuel was quietly traded and stable, still deriving support from scanty supplies, even though better volumes of Russian fuel oil appear to be on the horizon. One percent was on offer at $92 to $96 with fair value mid-way.
Gas oil firmed in line with August IPE, which last traded up $3.25 at $171.00 a tonne. Spreads were stable and cargoes inactive. Heating oil barges moved at 50 cents to $1 over August IPE.
